_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (materials/petrochemicals). Source: SABIC FY2025 results, Feb 2026 (sabic.com), confirmed by Argaam / Investing.com. Revenue SAR 116.53bn (-1% YoY). REPORTED net loss SAR 25.78bn (vs SAR 1.5bn net profit in 2024) — the loss is driven by large NON-CASH impairments and Q1-2025 strategic-restructuring one-offs plus fair-value finance costs, NOT operating collapse: net ADJUSTED income (ex one-offs) was +SAR 2.1bn, and free cash flow rose 17% to SAR 7.2bn. SABIC declared SAR 4.5bn interim dividends for 2H2025. net_profit_mn carries the reported IFRS loss; growth omitted (swing from profit to loss is out of sanity bounds). EPS/ROE/EBITDA not used (loss-distorted / not cleanly disclosed).
